text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 11: Month by month, the paired difference from B0 at the day- ahead lead'
text.tspan: Figure 11: Month by month, the paired difference from B0 at the day-

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each bar: the mean over plants, training runs (seeds), and hours of one arm's mean absolute error minus B0's in one calendar month, at lead-day 1 (the forecast for the day after the day it is issued). Per-plant fits, primary (default XGBoost) setting. Below zero beats B0. AN is the arm the screening rule picked from the first 10 months. All rows are exploratory. Arms. B0: the baseline with no lag. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast). AN: the analogue ensemble, the power on the 5 recent days whose forecast clear-sky index (the forecast's irradiance relative to clear sky) was closest to the target day's.'
text.tspan: Each bar: the mean over plants, training runs (seeds), and hours of one arm's mean absolute error minus B0's in one
calendar month, at lead-day 1 (the forecast for the day after the day it is issued).

from the first 10 months. All rows are exploratory.
Arms. B0: the baseline with no lag. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the
forecast was issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast). AN: the analogue ensemble, the power
